title: Semantic Dependency Specification
description: Semantic Dependency captures meaning presupposition without necessarily imposing hard load-order. Specification only.
definition: Record A has a Semantic Dependency on record B when a correct understanding of A's canonical meaning presupposes B, even if A can be stored or drafted without B being official.

rules.statement: Semantic Dependency SHOULD be declared when authors rely on another concept in the definition prose.
If semantic presupposition is actually required for correctness of the Canonical Definition, upgrade to Hard Dependency.
Semantic Dependency alone MUST NOT replace bibliography support for academic assertions.
Do not encode Semantic Dependency by inventing edge type synonyms; use registered levels and ontology edge types.

examples_of_use.note: Wu Xing framing presupposes Yin Yang polarity conceptually; Pack 01 may also declare Hard Dependency where required.
Qi discussion often presupposes Yin Yang; classify Hard vs Semantic per pack design.

relationship_to_other_levels.vs_hard_dependency: Hard blocks release; Semantic warns and documents meaning order.
relationship_to_other_levels.vs_soft_dependency: Soft is optional completeness; Semantic is about meaning presupposition.
relationship_to_other_levels.vs_reference: Reference is citation/pointer; Semantic is interpretive necessity.
